summary: Provide a first-run terminal UI entry point to open the newly published Smalltalk Assistant conversation.

replay.detail: No claim replay, projection rebuild or store recovery changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema transitions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated fleet-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The UI library accepts a programmatic initial agent subject. It waits for fresh live agent and granted space inventory, opens the agent conversation once and preserves later navigation. Input before readiness cancels the request; an absent subject is not retried. Default UI launches are unchanged and paired-device mode ignores this request. No new CLI flag, wire format or profile transition.

downtime.detail: No daemon lifecycle changes or additional service restart requirement.

manual.detail: No manual step or persisted-state migration for this optional UI entry point.

recovery.detail: No persisted-state format transition; removing the initial-subject request retains the ordinary restored UI view.
